task_intent: Elevate Tessera’s five word games with expressive native controls and matching wall compositions.

G03.name: Connections

mobbin.observed: A complete grid of word and phrase cards; muted green distinguishes selected matches, while every tile remains a stable target.
mobbin.applied: Stable word tiles, explicit checkmarks in selected cells, full multi-line phrases on the phone, and a consistent four-column wall grid.

primary_web.applied: Retain sixteen words, groups of four, four difficulty levels and four available mistakes. Revealed categories retain both their number and color, so completion is readable without color recognition.

G03.implementation: Phone and 64/192/512 wall share solved groups above a four-column unsolved board. Wall labels travel within their own tile only when the physical pixels cannot contain the whole word. Finished boards reveal all four groups without a banner obscuring them.

G04.name: Spelling Bee

mobbin.observed: A restrained milestone grid makes the current hexagonal achievement prominent and pairs large numerals with concise labels.
mobbin.applied: One honey-colored center hexagon, prominent earned points and rank, and a quieter word ledger. This is a visual hierarchy reference, not a claim that Mobbin supplied a Spelling Bee screen.

primary_web.applied: Keep the central letter mandatory, track found words and pangrams separately, and make achieved rank legible throughout play.

G04.implementation: Phone and wall use the same flat-top seven-cell hive with a required-letter underline, score/rank above and accepted-word feedback below. Shuffle is an acknowledged outer-letter reorder. Drafts clear only when the submitted word appears in the accepted found-word ledger.

verification.root_owned: Native build/captures, matched final comparisons, physical wall and phone deployment.
